title: Semantic Observability for Autonomous Systems Diagnostics
title_zh: 面向自主系统诊断的语义可观测性

paragraphs.en: 总结：本文提出“语义可观测性”多智能体框架，将异构日志统一为属性图数据库，自主定位故障根因并生成修复建议。 Modern distributed microservice deployments generate massive volumes of heterogeneous, multi-format observability logs across physically and logically partitioned infrastructure. Isolating root causes during cascading failures remains an arduous task for Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), bottlenecked by manual keyword filtering and disjointed temporal correlation across monitoring dashboards. We introduce Semantic Observability, an autonomous multi-agent framework that unifies disparate log streams into a dynamic, queryable Property Graph Database. By modeling physical infrastructure topologies, logical software dependencies, and chronological event sequences as attributed nodes and directed relations, it bridges the semantic gap inherent in flat, unstructured log repositories. Building on this unified substrate, we deploy a stateful multi-agent system orchestrated through Directed Cyclic Graphs (DCGs). The system autonomously navigates the topology, applying causal graph algorithms and temporal back-traversal to isolate the precise blast radius of anomalies. The pruned subgraph is then interpreted by a Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning engine to generate contextualized, code-level Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and actionable remediations. This paper establishes the foundational system architecture, formal relational ontology, and multi-agent control loops of Semantic Observability. We show conceptually how the framework eliminates ambient telemetry noise, reduces Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR), compresses LLM token consumption, and prevents structural hallucinations. We also specify an open-source validation framework on standard benchmarks (LogHub and Train-Ticket), laying the groundwork for a forthcoming companion paper on exhaustive quantitative evaluation and production benchmarking.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：本文提出“语义可观测性”多智能体框架，将异构日志统一为属性图数据库，自主定位故障根因并生成修复建议。现代分布式微服务部署在物理与逻辑上均被分片的基础设施中，产生海量的异构、多格式可观测性日志。 在级联故障中隔离根因，对站点可靠性工程师（SRE）而言仍是一项艰巨的任务，其瓶颈在于手动关键词过滤以及监控仪表盘之间割裂的时间关联。 我们提出语义可观测性（Semantic Observability），这是一个自主的多智能体框架，将彼此分离的日志流统一到一个动态、可查询的属性图数据库中。 通过将物理基础设施拓扑、逻辑软件依赖以及按时间顺序排列的事件序列建模为带属性的节点和有向关系，该框架弥合了扁平化、非结构化日志存储库中固有的语义鸿沟。 基于这一统一的底层结构，我们部署了一个由有向循环图（DCG）编排的有状态多智能体系统。 该系统自主地在拓扑中导航，应用因果图算法和时间回溯来隔离异常的精确影响范围。 剪枝后的子图随后由大语言模型（LLM）推理引擎进行解读，以生成具有上下文的、代码级别的根因分析（RCA）以及可执行的修复措施。 本文确立了语义可观测性的基础系统架构、形式化的关系本体以及多智能体控制回路。 我们从概念上展示该框架如何消除环境遥测噪声、缩短平均解决时间（MTTR）、压缩 LLM 的 token 消耗，并防止结构性幻觉。 我们还规定了基于标准基准（LogHub 和 Train-Ticket）的开源验证框架，为后续一篇关于全面定量评估与生产环境基准测试的姊妹论文奠定基础。
